description: This file implements the SetVolume class, which is responsible for setting the volume of a media stream within a specific context. It includes logging, validation of the pipeline, and calls to a wrapper for GStreamer functions.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic to set the volume of a media stream in a given context.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVolume object with context, a GStreamer wrapper, and the desired volume.

methods.name: ~SetVolume
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetVolume operation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the volume setting operation, validating the pipeline and calling the GStreamer wrapper to set the volume.
